messages:
maria: quick notefrom today's model onboarding run for aurora-ptq-lite. we saw structured-output regressions focused on funcall argument ordering and occasional stray single-quote characters.

sam: single quotes? likely tokenization artifacts after quantization. can you paste a snippet?

maria: example from failed parse: 
```
Assistant: {\"action\":\"call\",\"name\":\"open_url\",\"arguments\":{\"url\":\"https://example.com\",\"title\":\"Example\"\' }}
```

heng: that trailing single-quote is nasty. might be due to token merge when concatenating kv-prefix with prompt. Also see argument key order shuffled vs schema expectations (we expect url then title then metadata).

maria: our schema check is strict-order for a subset of calls because downstream tools rely on stable serialization for signature hashing. order drift causes signature mismatch failures.

sam: we should avoid enforcing rigid key-order in tools; use canonical sort on both sides for hashing. For now, though, can we relax schema-check in the canary?

maria: plan: 1) add sanitizer to strip stray single-quotes outside strings, using a conservative heuristic: only remove a trailing single-quote if it is preceded by a double-quote and followed by whitespace/closing brace. 2) update signature verification to canonicalize keys before hashing. 3) add a small prompt tweak telling models: \"Return JSON object with keys in this order: url, title, metadata.\" but mark as advisory.

heng: for 1) ensure we don't touch valid single-quote characters inside strings. maybe run a JSON parse probe first, and only if parse fails do the single-quote strip.

ci-bot: job started: job/aurora-ptq-lite-3498 (400 samples) -> https://ci.redwood/job/aurora-ptq-lite-3498

maria: telemetry fields to add: `schema_order_violation` (bool), `trailing_single_quote` (bool), `canonicalized_signature` (bool), `repair_action` (none,strip_quote,strip_comma,ndjson_split).

sam: add `signature_mismatch_fatal` flag so we can see product impacts. Also record `repair_confidence` (low/med/high) for heuristics.

maria: canary results: 400 samples -> parse_failures: 9, repaired: 5 (strip_quote + comma strip), fallback:4. signature mismatches decreased after canonicalization test by 60% in sample. repair median latency +65ms.

heng: good improvement. let's schedule a follow-up to consider moving to JSON Web Signature for calls so ordering won't matter.

maria: will draft RFC. will also land the sanitizer PR with unit tests. I'll post PR link when ready.
